resources.string: Follow the simple steps to create your handwriting.
2) Print this template and fill it. Try to fill it with free hand for adding some realistic look. You can also add some cutout letters in place of \'special characters\'.
3) Scan this template and send it to the below email address. After some time, you\'ll receive an email which will contain your font (otf) file.
4) Alternatively, instead of sending it to us, you can also create your otf file from Calligraphr. After building font, download \'otf\' file only.
5) After obtaining your font (otf) file. Move it to Writer/Font folder with name as \'myWriting.otf\'.
6) That\'s it. You\'re good to go.
Tip: While creating your font at Calligraphr, set Letter Spacing to 10% for adding realistic look.
For changing the font, move your otf file to Writer/Font folder with name as \"myWriting.otf\".
For using your custom page background, copy your background image to Writer/Background folder with name as \"page_bg.png\".
For creating a pdf file, select the images from below list and click on \'Create Pdf\'.
Make sure the images are in Writer/Images folder.
